subject: {first_name}, I built this after one too many "he's due" takes
preview_text: Calibrated picks on match winner, total games, and handicap — verify every result.
body_paragraphs: Every match day, the same scene: a group chat full of hot takes — "he's due," "clay doesn't matter," "I just feel a bagel." Nobody checking form, surface, or what the numbers actually say.

I built Predictify Tennis because tennis arguments shouldn't be won by whoever talks loudest. We wanted forecasts you can pressure-test: Elo, surface, recent form, H2H, and a calibrated confidence score on match winner, total games, games handicap, first set, and straight sets.

A friend of ours learned this the hard way on a slam night. The model flagged a favorite at 58% confidence — basically a coin flip. He ignored it, went with gut feel, and lost the argument and the bet. Two weeks later he opened a pick in our highest-confidence band (80%+ tier), read the breakdown, and called it before first serve. Same friend. Different process.
That's why we publish every result — wins and losses — so you can verify the track record yourself, match by match. No hidden picks. No rewriting history after match point.
Your next step takes about 30 seconds: open today's slate, pick one match, and read the reasoning before you lock in your call.
P.S. We're not a bookmaker. No guaranteed wins — just transparent forecasts and a record you can check.
